metadata.source: Georgia Secretary of State absentee ballot file and active voter registration table

warnings: 2022: 2 counties are short in the absentee file (Fulton (133,278 in the file vs 305,815 official), Gwinnett (119,446 in the file vs 192,162 official)); the comparison is cut at 2022-10-22, the last complete day; the repeat-voter figure comes from the voter history file
6 accepted ballots were dropped for a missing or out-of-range return date
9,203 repeat records for the same voter were merged (best status kept)

countyContext.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, via Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org)
countyContext.note: citizenAdults = adults 18+ minus non-citizen residents of ALL ages (B05002 has no age split), so it runs slightly low; an estimate, not the Census citizen voting-age population
